author: Animan
description:
Underrated anime hidden gems you probably missed — Top 10 Underrated Anime You Need to Watch. These 10 range from psychological thrillers and dark fantasy to hilarious action, political conspiracies, and wholesome assassin comedies — hidden masterpieces most fans have never seen.

I ranked 10 severely underrated anime — Den-noh Coil, Babylon, ACCA, Kemono Jihen, Kill Blue and more — that got starved of attention despite being genuinely elite. Some are old, some are brand new, but they all deserve more people talking about them. Timestamps below so you can jump to whichever gem catches your eye.

👇 Which one are you adding first — and which underrated banger did I miss? Drop it so someone scrolling right now can find it.
